note: On a DEQCorrector both toggles are structural no-ops: the DEQ branch in correction_loop.py (lines 148-177) bypasses trust-gating and the backtracking acceptance test. There is no acceptance-test flag in CorrectionConfig; the test is hardcoded in the non-DEQ loop, which is never entered for a DEQ corrector. These toggles are only live for a 'local' corrector. step_size is the only knob the DEQ branch reads (it scales the applied delta).
